---
name: Review a clinical rule
about: A rule in rules/ is wrong, outdated, or does not match practice in India
labels: rules, clinical
---

**No coding needed for this, and it is one of the most valuable things anyone can do here.**

**Which rule?**
The file name, or just describe it.

**What is wrong with it?**
Wrong threshold, wrong interval, outdated guideline, or simply not how things work in practice.

**What should it be?**
If you know. If you only know that the current version is wrong, that is still worth telling us.

**Source or experience?**
A guideline reference if you have one. If this comes from clinical practice rather than a
document, please say so - we would rather know.

**Your background, if you are happy to share it**
Helps us route this to the right reviewer. Entirely optional.
